decision.build: Defer prefix/suffix memoization: each initial boundary query has unique observed offset/context signature; both prefix width and suffix renderability are required. Prefix+suffix central input per complete single-glyph cluster is B*(B-1) for these ASCII grapheme cases, but no strict duplicate build call or measured implementation gain. Do not proportionally cut glyph advances or omit suffix validation.
decision.adopt: Conditional per-public-line-call continuation width memo candidate for successful warning-free, unsaturated exact queries only. Actual repeated observed signatures justify investigating it; no cache implemented or measured speedup promised. Existing EdgeShapeCache should not be labelled missing or rewritten without demonstrating equivalence.
